user.title: PlayStation 5
user.description: Select your PS5 or enter its IP address. It must be on or in rest mode.

data_description.host: Found in your network, or enter an IP address.

link.title: Link {name}
link.description:
On the PS5 open Settings → System → Remote Play → Link Device and enter the 8-digit PIN.

PSN account ID: enter it if you know it (numeric). Otherwise leave it empty and paste an NPSSO token instead: sign in at playstation.com, then open {sso_url} and copy the value after "npsso". The token is only used once to look up the ID and is not stored.

data.npsso: NPSSO token (instead of the account ID)

data_description.npsso: 64 characters from {sso_url} after signing in at playstation.com.

error.cannot_connect: The PS5 does not answer. Is it on or in rest mode?
error.not_linking: The PS5 is not waiting for a link. Open “Link Device” on the PS5 first.
error.link_failed: Linking failed: wrong PIN or account ID.
error.invalid_account: Enter the numeric PSN account ID.
error.invalid_npsso: Sony rejected the NPSSO token. Sign in again at playstation.com and copy a fresh one.
error.psn_unreachable: Sony could not be reached to look up the account ID. Try again or enter the ID.
error.account_missing: Enter the PSN account ID or an NPSSO token.

abort.already_configured: This PS5 is already set up.
abort.wrong_device: A different PS5 answers at this address.

command_failed.message: The PS5 did not accept the command: {error}

not_linked.message: The PS5 no longer knows this link. Link it again.

psn_expired.message: PSN login expired – renew it under Repairs.

firmware_unreachable.message: Sony's system software page not reachable: {error}

firmware_no_version.message: No version number found on Sony's system software page.

init.title: PlayStation Network (optional)
init.description:
Control stays local. With the PSN cloud HA also shows the running game with cover, online status, trophies, avatar and PS Plus.

To switch it on or renew it: sign in at playstation.com, open {sso_url} and paste the value after "npsso" (or the whole line). Only a renewal token is stored.
